artifact.transcript:
AI: Hello, thanks for contacting Your Agency. I'm Roy, the AI Discovery Consultant. What would you like to make easier in your business?
User: We run a small courier company. Requests come in by email and WhatsApp and we copy them into a spreadsheet by hand.
AI: That sounds time-consuming. Which part causes the most trouble?
User: Some requests get missed, and customers keep asking for status updates.
AI: Understood. Which tools does your team use today?
User: WhatsApp Business, Gmail and Google Sheets.
AI: What would you like the process to look like instead?
User: One central place for requests, less manual entry, and automatic status updates.
AI: Could I take a name and the best way to reach you?
User: Jane Doe, jane@example.com.
AI: Thank you for your time. The team will review what you've shared. Have a good day. Goodbye.

messages.message: Hello, thanks for contacting Your Agency. I'm Roy, the AI Discovery Consultant. What would you like to make easier in your business?
We run a small courier company. Requests come in by email and WhatsApp and we copy them into a spreadsheet by hand.

result.business_need: Delivery requests arrive through several channels and are copied into a spreadsheet by hand. Some are missed and customers repeatedly ask for status updates.
result.current_process: Staff receive requests by email and WhatsApp, enter them into a spreadsheet and answer status questions manually.
result.business_impact: Staff time goes on repetitive admin and there is little visibility of outstanding requests.
result.desired_outcome: Centralize incoming requests, reduce manual entry and send timely delivery status updates.
